description.value:
Frequency once per round

Interact to retrieve a prepared Graft and throw it as part of the same action. If the target is unaware of you, that Graft’s save DC increases by 1 against it.

cinderfall.incomplete: The action-economy compression (retrieve-and-throw as one action) matches Pattern ACTION-FREE and needs no rules entry (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/shared-class-feats/level-2/quick-draw.json, rules: []). The "+1 DC if the target is unaware of you" clause is unhookable: pf2e doesn't expose a generic "target is unaware of you" predicate distinct from off-guard/flanking.
